ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels and 60% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous blobs occupy the outer two-thirds of both the left and right lobes. A broad, solid black central corridor extends from the fluke root to the median notch. The trailing and leading edges are bordered by a black margin of varying thickness, with a distinct black circular focal spot located in the upper-right white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped indentation with an estimated pixel-calculated interior angle of 72 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing boundary. High-amplitude, sharp peaks (approx. 5-12 pixels in depth) are concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe, while the left lobe exhibits more rounded, lower-frequency undulations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted from the median notch extending outward and upward toward tapered, sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) located on the distal-most white region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical white linear streaks located in the central black pigmentation zone, approximately 15% of the distance from the notch to the left tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant jagged notch or traumatic indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately 10 centimeters from the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The interface between the central black corridor and the white lateral patches is highly feathered and asymmetrical, particularly on the left lobe.
